_comment: The How-to page's category tree (docs/design/how-to.md, 'A category'; shape in schemas/how_to.toml, [category]). Unlimited depth. Every how-to sits in exactly ONE node (its `category`), and its file lives in the folder named after that node's TOP-level ancestor: data/how_to/<top id>/<how-to id>.json, so agents writing Food and Household how-tos in parallel never touch the same folder. Ids are unique across the whole tree and never reused. `icon` is a painter name from src/gui/widgets/icons.rs (paint_<name>); the website maps the same names in web/pages/how-to-app.js. `subjects` are Curriculum subject ids (data/curriculum/syllabus.json) a branch practises; `help` names Help and Services categories of data/external/catalog.json. Organised by where in life a task sits, not by subject: the Curriculum is the subject map, linked through `subjects`. A new category is a new node here, never code.
